## Change
Describe the behavior change and link the relevant issue.

## Validation
List commands, configurations, and results. State which GPU or simulator checks were not run.

## Checklist
- [ ] The change is limited to its stated purpose.
- [ ] Public commands and data formats are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private infrastructure paths, model weights, or generated media are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices are preserved.
